us_invested.summary:
* **HIMS (HIMS)** - Faces an FTC lawsuit, multiple class action complaints regarding billing and data practices, and a securities fraud suit, while FirstWave Capital increased its stake by 30.6%.
* **JNJ (JNJ)** - Analysts highlighted recent new highs and upside potential, Saranac Partners reduced its stake, and management will attend the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference on September 9.
* **KRYS (KRYS)** - The CEO and President of R&D each sold approximately $8.98 million in shares under Rule 10b5-1 plans, while Odyssean LLC increased its Q2 position.
* **META (META)** - Settled a social media addiction lawsuit for up to $17.1 billion, received an analyst downgrade from Seeking Alpha, and saw SYM Financial reduce its stake by 27.6%.
* **Oracle (ORCL)** - Shares rose 3% on an expanded HPE AI infrastructure partnership and strong cloud backlog, with NBH Bank establishing a new $784,000 stake.
* **QURE (QURE)** - Downgraded to a "Sell" rating by Wall Street Zen on September 5, 2026.
* **RKLB (RKLB)** - Upgraded to "strong buy" at Berenberg Bank alongside institutional buys from ARK Invest and Nykredit, while reports suggest the Neutron rocket launch could face delays to 2027.
* **Twist Bioscience (TWST)** - ARK Invest sold 12,300 shares (approximately $1.58 million) on September 4, 2026.
* **ZS (ZS)** - Shares dropped 4.5% on conservative FY2027 guidance despite a fiscal Q4 beat, as the company prepares to launch Agentic SecOps and present at upcoming conferences on September 9.
* **RGEN (RGEN)** - Analysts maintained a consensus "Buy" rating ($166.43 target), B. Metzler raised its stake by 52.8%, and leadership is slated to present at the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference on September 9.
* **Amkor (AMKR)** - Highlighted by Simply Wall St and Zacks as a top value bargain in semiconductor packaging and testing following upgraded earnings estimates.
* **ARM (ARM)** - Shares gained 5.5% amid an AI chip rally following strong US jobs data and rising rate hike expectations.
